learn.hook: A plant is like a little factory with many parts. Each part has its own job!
points: Most plants have roots, a stem, leaves, flowers, fruits and seeds.
Roots grow under the soil. They hold the plant firmly and take in water from the soil.
The stem holds the plant up and carries water from the roots to the leaves.
Leaves make food for the plant using sunlight, air and water.
Plants come in many sizes: tiny grass, bushy shrubs like the rose, and tall trees like the neem and banyan.

example.q: Anu pulls a weed out of the garden. It comes out with long thin threads at the bottom, full of soil. What are these threads, and what did they do for the weed?
steps: The threads were under the soil.
The part of a plant that grows under the soil is the root.
Roots hold the plant in the soil and take in water.
example.answer: They are roots. They held the weed in the soil and took in water.

learn.reallife: Next time you water a pot plant, remember: the roots drink the water, and the stem carries it up to the leaves.

games.title: Part and its job
pairs: Holds the plant in the soil
Carries water up to the leaves
Can grow into a new plant

games.title: A tree from bottom to top
games.prompt: Start from the part deep in the soil

quiz.q: Which part of a plant holds it firmly in the soil?
quiz.explain: Roots spread in the soil and hold the plant in place, like an anchor.
steps: Roots grow under the soil.
They hold the plant firmly.
So the root holds the plant in the soil.
Answer: Root
quiz.mistake: Thinks the stem holds the plant in the soil

quiz.q: Which part carries water from the roots to the leaves?
quiz.explain: The stem works like a pipe that carries water up to the leaves.
steps: The stem holds the plant up.
It carries water from the roots to the leaves.
So the answer is the stem.
Answer: Stem
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the jobs of roots and stems

quiz.q: Which part of a plant makes food for it?
quiz.explain: Leaves use sunlight, air and water to make food for the plant.
steps: Leaves use sunlight, air and water.
They make food for the plant.
So the leaf makes food.
Answer: Leaf
quiz.mistake: Thinks plants take food from the soil

quiz.q: A carrot is which part of the plant?
quiz.explain: The orange part of a carrot grows under the soil. It is a root that stores food.
steps: The orange part of a carrot grows under the soil.
Parts under the soil that hold the plant are roots.
So a carrot is a root.
Answer: Root
quiz.mistake: Thinks everything we eat is a fruit

quiz.q: Which of these is a tall tree?
quiz.explain: Neem grows into a big tree with a thick, hard trunk. The others are small plants.
steps: Trees are tall plants, like neem and banyan.
Grass, mint and tulsi are small plants.
So neem is a tall tree.
Answer: Neem
quiz.mistake: Mixes up herbs with trees

quiz.q: Which plant is a shrub — bushy, with many woody stems, but not as tall as a tree?
quiz.explain: A rose plant is a shrub. Mango, peepal and coconut are tall trees.
steps: A shrub is bushy, with woody stems, but not tall like a tree.
The rose is a shrub.
Mango, peepal and coconut are tall trees.
Answer: Rose
quiz.mistake: Thinks any plant with flowers is a tree

quiz.q: The thick, hard stem of a tree is called the ___.
quiz.explain: A tree's main stem is called its trunk. It is hard and woody.
steps: A tree has a thick, hard main stem.
This is called the trunk.
So the answer is trunk.
Answer: Trunk
quiz.mistake: Does not know the word trunk

quiz.q: Most plants need which of these to grow well?
quiz.explain: Plants need sunlight, water and air to make food and stay healthy.
steps: Leaves make food using sunlight, air and water.
So plants need sunlight, water and air to grow well.
Answer: Sunlight, water and air
quiz.mistake: Does not know what plants need

teach.ask: Gappu sees a plant in a pot and wonders what all its parts do. Can you explain?
teach.praise: Chirp! Roots drink, the stem carries and the leaves cook. What a team!
teach.nudge: Which part makes food for the plant?

revise.summary: Most plants have roots, a stem, leaves, flowers, fruits and seeds. Roots hold the plant and take in water, the stem carries water up, and leaves make food. Plants can be grass, shrubs or tall trees.
focus: Sizes of plants: grass, shrub, tree
remember: Roots: hold the plant and take in water
Stem: holds the plant up and carries water to the leaves
Leaves: make food using sunlight, air and water
traps: A carrot is a root, not a stem.
A rose is a shrub, not a tree.

learn.hook: Have you ever seen two leaves that look exactly alike? Leaves and flowers are full of surprises!
points: Leaves come in many shapes and sizes: the banana leaf is huge, and the tulsi leaf is small.
A leaf has a flat part, thin lines called veins, and a small stalk joining it to the stem.
Most leaves are green. Leaves use sunlight to make food for the plant.
Flowers have colourful petals and many have a sweet smell.
Bees and butterflies visit flowers. After this, many flowers grow into fruits with seeds inside.

example.q: Rohit sees bees buzzing around the mustard flowers in the field. Later, the flowers turn into thin pods. What is happening?
steps: Bees visit flowers to drink their sweet juice, called nectar.
This visit helps the flowers to make seeds.
The flowers then change into pods, which are the fruits that hold mustard seeds.
example.answer: The flowers are turning into pods (fruits) with seeds inside

learn.reallife: Collect fallen leaves in your park and compare their shapes, sizes and edges. Do not pluck leaves from plants!

games.title: Leaf and flower facts
items: A banana leaf is bigger than a tulsi leaf.
Banana leaves are big enough to eat a meal on!
Leaves have thin lines on them called veins.
Veins carry water through the leaf.
Leaves make food for the plant using sunlight.
That is why most plants grow towards light.
Flowers come in many colours, like yellow marigolds and white jasmine.
Bees visit flowers for their sweet nectar.
Bees use nectar to make honey.
The lotus grows in ponds and lakes.

quiz.q: Which part do we eat in spinach (palak)?
quiz.explain: We cook and eat the green leaves of the spinach plant.
steps: Spinach (palak) is a green leafy vegetable.
We cook and eat its leaves.
So we eat the leaves.
Answer: Leaves
quiz.mistake: Does not link vegetables to plant parts

quiz.q: Which part of the cauliflower plant do we eat?
quiz.explain: The white part of a cauliflower is a tight bunch of flower buds.
steps: The white part of a cauliflower is a tight bunch of flower buds.
So we eat the flower.
Answer: Flower
quiz.mistake: Thinks cauliflower is a leaf because it is a vegetable

quiz.q: The thin lines you see on a leaf are called ___.
quiz.explain: Veins are thin lines that carry water to all parts of the leaf.
steps: A leaf has thin lines on it.
These are called veins.
So the answer is veins.
Answer: Veins
quiz.mistake: Mixes up leaf parts with flower parts

quiz.q: Why do bees visit flowers?
options: To build nests in the stem
quiz.explain: Bees drink nectar from flowers and use it to make honey.
steps: Bees visit flowers.
They drink sweet nectar and make honey.
So bees visit to drink nectar.
Answer: To drink their sweet nectar
quiz.mistake: Does not know what bees get from flowers

quiz.q: Which flower grows in ponds and is India's national flower?
quiz.explain: The lotus grows in water and is the national flower of India.
steps: The lotus grows in ponds.
It is India's national flower.
So the answer is lotus.
Answer: Lotus
quiz.mistake: Guesses a popular garden flower

quiz.q: Which of these is the colourful part of a flower?
quiz.explain: Petals are the soft, colourful parts of a flower.
steps: Flowers have colourful petals.
Roots, trunk and bark are not parts of a flower.
So petals are the colourful part.
Answer: Petals
quiz.mistake: Mixes up flower parts with tree parts

quiz.q: Which plant has very big leaves that are used as plates in South India?
quiz.explain: Banana leaves are large and strong, so food is served on them.
steps: The banana leaf is huge.
In South India food is served on banana leaves.
So the answer is banana.
Answer: Banana
quiz.mistake: Picks a plant with small leaves

quiz.q: After a flower is visited by bees, what does it often grow into?
quiz.explain: Many flowers turn into fruits, and the fruits hold seeds.
steps: Bees and butterflies visit flowers.
After this, many flowers grow into fruits with seeds inside.
So it grows into a fruit with seeds.
Answer: A fruit with seeds
quiz.mistake: Does not know that fruits come from flowers

teach.ask: Gappu found a fallen leaf and a flower. He asks: what is special about leaves and flowers?
teach.praise: Tweet! Leaves cook food and flowers turn into fruits. Wow!

revise.summary: Leaves come in many shapes and sizes and have veins. Flowers have colourful petals; bees and butterflies visit them, and many flowers then grow into fruits with seeds.
focus: Which part of a plant we eat (palak, cauliflower)
remember: Veins = thin lines on a leaf
Petals = colourful parts of a flower
Bees drink nectar and make honey
Lotus grows in ponds and is India's national flower
traps: We eat the flower of the cauliflower, not its leaves.
Many flowers turn into fruits with seeds, not into new leaves.

learn.hook: A giant banyan tree starts as one tiny seed. How does a seed become a plant?
points: Seeds are found inside fruits. A mango has one big seed; a papaya has many small seeds.
A seed can grow into a new plant when it gets water, air and warmth.
When a seed starts to grow, a tiny root comes out first, and then a small shoot.
Seeds travel to new places. Cotton and aak (madar) seeds fly with the wind, coconuts float on water, and birds drop seeds of fruits they eat.
We eat many seeds, like rice, wheat, dal, peas and peanuts.

example.q: Simran soaks moong seeds in water overnight and keeps them wrapped in a wet cloth. After a day, tiny white tails appear. What has happened?
steps: The seeds got water, air and warmth.
They started to grow, which we call sprouting.
The tiny white tail is the first root of the new plant.
example.answer: The seeds have sprouted. The white tail is the first root.

learn.reallife: Sprouted moong is eaten as a healthy snack in many Indian homes. You can grow your own with an adult's help!

games.title: How a seed grows
items: Seed soaks up water and swells

quiz.q: What does a seed need to start growing?
options: A dark plastic box with no air
quiz.explain: Seeds need water, air and warmth to sprout.
steps: A seed can grow when it gets water, air and warmth.
So a seed needs water, air and warmth.
Answer: Water, air and warmth
quiz.mistake: Thinks seeds can grow without water and air

quiz.q: When a seed sprouts, which part usually comes out first?
quiz.explain: The root comes out first so the young plant can hold on and take in water.
steps: When a seed starts to grow, a tiny root comes out first.
Then a small shoot comes out.
So a tiny root comes out first.
Answer: A tiny root
quiz.mistake: Thinks leaves come first

quiz.q: How do cotton seeds travel to new places?
options: They are blown by the wind
quiz.explain: Cotton seeds have soft fluffy hairs that help the wind carry them.
steps: Cotton seeds are light and fluffy.
They fly with the wind.
So they are blown by the wind.
Answer: They are blown by the wind
quiz.mistake: Does not know how light seeds spread

quiz.q: How can a coconut travel far away?
quiz.explain: A coconut has a light, hairy covering that helps it float on sea water.
steps: Coconuts can float.
So they travel far by floating on water.
Answer: It floats on water
quiz.mistake: Mixes up seed travel methods

quiz.q: Which fruit has only ONE big seed?
quiz.explain: A mango has one big seed in the middle. The others have many seeds.
steps: A mango has one big seed.
Papaya, watermelon and guava have many seeds.
So the answer is mango.
Answer: Mango
quiz.mistake: Does not think about seeds inside fruits

quiz.q: Which of these is a seed that we eat?
quiz.explain: Rice grains are seeds. We also eat wheat, dal and peas, which are seeds.
steps: We eat many seeds, like rice, wheat, dal, peas and peanuts.
Rice grains are seeds.
So the answer is rice.
Answer: Rice
quiz.mistake: Does not know that grains are seeds

quiz.q: Rahul planted 4 seeds in each of his 3 pots. How many seeds did he plant in all?
quiz.explain: 3 pots with 4 seeds in each is 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 seeds.
steps: 3 pots × 4 seeds
Answer: 12
quiz.mistake: Adds the numbers instead of making equal groups

quiz.q: Why do seeds need to travel away from the parent plant?
options: So they can go to school
Because they dislike the parent plant
So they can turn into stones
So the new plants get enough space, water and light
quiz.explain: If all seeds fell under the parent plant, they would be crowded and get less light and water.
steps: If all seeds fell under the parent plant, they would be crowded.
They would get less space, water and light.
So seeds travel so new plants get enough of these.
Answer: So the new plants get enough space, water and light
quiz.mistake: Does not see why spreading out helps plants

teach.ask: Gappu found a seed and wants it to grow into a tree. He asks: what does a seed need, and how does it grow?
teach.praise: Chirp! I will give my seed water and air and wait for it to sprout!
teach.nudge: What comes out first when a seed starts to grow?

revise.summary: Seeds are found inside fruits. With water, air and warmth a seed sprouts: first a tiny root, then a shoot. Seeds travel by wind, water and animals, and we eat many seeds.
focus: What comes out first when a seed sprouts
remember: Seeds need water, air and warmth to grow
The tiny root comes out first, then the shoot
Cotton and aak fly with the wind; coconut floats; birds drop seeds
Mango has one big seed; papaya has many
traps: The leaf does not come out first; the root does.
Seeds do not need darkness or salt to grow.
